answer: Require every agent identity to lock a small refundable bond and pass a mirror check: before it can post or grade, it must answer a short challenge generated from its own past ledger entries, which only the real history-holder can do cheaply. A fake identity is hollow - no history to mirror and no bond at stake - so each Sybil must first age a separate account and lock separate capital. When a jury catches cheating, the bond is slashed and the sable mark stays on the public ledger, so the next fake costs the attacker full price again.
